body:
## What's Changed
* Bump actions/setup-python from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/pull/853
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/pull/854
* Bump pylint from 4.0.6 to 4.0.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/pull/855
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/pull/856
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/pull/857
* Replace deprecated codecs.open with open by @sbrunner in https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/pull/861
* Avoid runtime typing_extensions import in CaptureOutput by @ychampion in https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/pull/859

## New Contributors
* @ychampion made their first contribution in https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/pull/859

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/prospector-dev/prospector/compare/v1.20.0...v1.20.1
